title.zh: 分析快 28 倍、MusicXML 多谱表、可用性修复
title.en: Analysis 28× faster, multi-part MusicXML, and usability fixes

highlights.zh: 五分钟音频首次分析从 287 秒降到 10.2 秒；新增"只看响度与频谱"的轻量模式。
highlights.en: A first five-minute analysis went from 287s to 10.2s, and a loudness-and-spectrum-only mode was added.

highlights.zh: MusicXML 可每个声部一个谱表；工程名随包传递，导出默认以标题命名。
highlights.en: MusicXML can export one part per lane; a project's name travels in its package and names the export.

highlights.zh: 空查询不再崩溃、未知轨道被拒绝、单边范围与时长预算如实报告、低音区音符在卷帘可见。
highlights.en: An empty search no longer crashes, unknown tracks are refused, one-sided spans and the duration budget report what they did, and bass notes are visible in the roll.

highlights.zh: 回包标明分析是否来自缓存；渲染说明 MP3 编码阶段；乐器列表给出实测音域与安全时长。
highlights.en: Replies say whether an analysis came from cache, a render announces its MP3 encode stage, and the instrument list gives the measured compass and safe duration.

title.zh: 编辑更快更省：音符应答改增量、卷帘只画可见格、六处可读性修复
title.en: Editing that is faster and lighter: delta note replies, a roll that draws only what is visible, and six readability fixes

highlights.zh: 改一个音符的回包不再带整首曲子：+4.9 KB/批 → +1 字节，`verbose: true` 可取回全量。
highlights.en: A note edit no longer returns the whole arrangement: +4.9 KB per batch became +1 byte, and `verbose: true` restores the old reply.

highlights.zh: 卷帘 126 小节从 74,592 个格子降到 2,368，且不再随曲长增长。
highlights.en: The roll's 126 bars went from 74,592 cells to 2,368, and the count no longer follows the length of the piece.

highlights.zh: 六处对比度修复改用各皮肤自己的墨色；pixel 皮肤不再吃微格热区、不再要半像素字号。
highlights.en: Six contrast fixes take each skin's own ink; the pixel skin no longer eats micro-cell hit areas or asks for half-pixel sizes.

highlights.zh: 乐器列表给出实测音域；力度在卷帘内可改；空查询不再崩溃。
highlights.en: The instrument list states the measured compass; a note's velocity is visible and editable inside the roll; an empty search no longer crashes.

title.zh: 长曲子渲染默认分块（快 2.5 倍）、单音符力度可看可改、导出报进度与剩余时间
title.en: Long renders 2.5× faster, a note's velocity you can see and change, and an export that says how much longer

highlights.zh: 五分钟渲染 753 秒 → 297 秒：长曲子默认多段多进程；等价性由逐样本判据守住。`chunks: 1` 可关。
highlights.en: A five-minute render went 753 s → 297 s: long pieces are chunked across processes by default, with sample-accurate equivalence held by a criterion; `chunks: 1` turns it off.

highlights.zh: 单个音符的力度现在看得到也改得了：音符带着力度，框选后用工具条调整，每音符一步撤销。
highlights.en: A note's velocity is visible and editable: notes carry their own value, and a selection can be re-voiced from the toolbar, one undo step per note.

highlights.zh: 导出的母带报进度与剩余时间，数字来自渲染器自己的每 10% 回调。
highlights.en: A master export reports progress and time left, from the renderer's own ten-percent callbacks.

highlights.zh: 导入的编曲与文件同长，并采用文件自己的速度与拍号。
highlights.en: An imported arrangement is as long as its file and takes the file's own tempo and meter.

title.zh: 编曲界面错位修复：轨道头、区域与工具条
title.en: Arrangement layout: headers, regions and the toolbar

highlights.zh: 轨道头与泳道逐行对齐，曲目名不再被挤成 0 宽。
highlights.en: Each header shares its lane's row box, and the track name is no longer squeezed to zero width.

highlights.zh: 区域落回小节网格（原先右移 36 px），通道里重复的 MUTE 退场。
highlights.en: Regions sit on the bar grid again (they were 36 px right of it); the lane's duplicate MUTE is gone.

highlights.zh: 工具条按家族分组，字形控件补了名称；落地页加流派筛选。
highlights.en: The toolbar is labelled by family and its glyph controls are named; the landing panel gains a genre filter.

highlights.zh: 新增逐屏截图审计；nightly 延迟探针跟回 v2 面。
highlights.en: New screen-by-screen audit with screenshots and geometry; the nightly latency probe follows the v2 surface.

title.zh: v1 退场：工作室界面、发布矩阵与 MCP 模式工具都换成编曲
title.en: v1 retires: the studio view, the release matrix and the MCP pattern tools become the arrangement

highlights.zh: 工作室界面、v1 模式工具与发布矩阵退役；人和智能体都只看编曲面。
highlights.en: The studio view, the v1 pattern tools and the release matrix are gone; a person and an agent both work on the arrangement.

highlights.zh: GS-1 音色改挂到编曲轨道，经 compile 进渲染，真核渲染有判据。
highlights.en: A track's own GS-1 sound is carried into the render by the compile, measured on the real core.

highlights.zh: 编曲面补齐静音、导出取消、采样等待提示、保存状态与主效果架。
highlights.en: The arrangement gains mute, export cancel, a sampler-waiting hint, save status and the master effects rack.

title.zh: 编曲能试听一段、Logic 工程能导出，经验也写成了 skill
title.en: Hear a passage of an arrangement, export it as a Logic project, and the lessons written down as skills

highlights.zh: 新增预览工具：只渲一段、可只出指定轨，默认 8 kHz 单声道；分轨渲染也支持小节范围。
highlights.en: A new preview renders one passage, optionally only the tracks you name, at 8 kHz mono by default; the stems renderer takes a bar span too.

highlights.zh: 新增 Logic 工程导出，能被本服务自己的导入器逐值读回；真 Logic 能否打开仍未证。
highlights.en: A new export writes a Logic project that this server's own importer reads back value for value; whether Logic itself opens it stays unproven.

title.zh: Logic 工程能导出了、配对文件修好两处保真损失
title.en: A Logic project can be exported, and the paired files fixed two writing losses

highlights.zh: 乐谱页头部多了一个「导出 Logic 工程（.logicx.zip）」：写出的是 Logic 的工程目录结构，浏览器交给你一个包。
highlights.en: The score header carries Export Logic Project (.logicx.zip): it writes a Logic project structure, and the browser hands you one package.

highlights.zh: 同曲 MIDI 与 MusicXML 配对互校，逼出两处听不出来的保真损失并修好：非网格音长不再被取整、重叠音不再被顺延两拍。
highlights.en: Cross-checking the same piece in MIDI and MusicXML exposed two silent fidelity losses, now fixed: off-grid note lengths are no longer rounded and overlapping notes are no longer pushed two beats late.

highlights.zh: 导出条数是跟着菜单算出来的，所以多一个导出项时那句文案会自己更新——这次它从 7 变成 8。
highlights.en: The stated export count is derived from the menu, so it follows a new export by itself: this time it went from seven to eight.

title.zh: 编曲工程列出来了、走带真跳、导出可取消
title.en: Arrangement projects are listed, the transport really seeks, and an export can be cancelled

highlights.zh: Hub 列出编曲工程，可打开、改名、删除，打开的是你点的那份。
highlights.en: The hub lists arrangement projects, with open, rename and delete, and Open enters the one you clicked.

highlights.zh: 新装就能看见「编曲」；点标尺会跳到那一小节，模板工程也真是 8 小节。
highlights.en: A fresh install shows Arrangement, a ruler click really seeks to that bar, and a template project really is eight bars.

highlights.zh: 按下播放就有「正在准备」（3204→280 毫秒）；导出母带报进度、能取消，取消后不出下载。
highlights.en: Play shows its preparing state at once (3,204 down to 280 ms), and a master export reports progress, can be cancelled, and produces no download once cancelled.

highlights.zh: 低音库覆盖所写音高、11 条越界曲风折回；Logic 工程 0→581 音符。
highlights.en: The picked bass reaches the notes that are written, eleven out-of-range genre lines fold back, and a Logic project reads 581 notes where it read none.

highlights.zh: 按名导入的声部真变成采样轨；深色谱面不再黑底黑字。
highlights.en: Parts imported with a chosen sampler name really become sampler tracks, and the stave is no longer black on a dark skin.

title.zh: 地址不再多一层、Studio 取录音、循环框真的循环
title.en: One directory fewer, the studio fetches its recordings, and the brace loops

highlights.zh: 循环框此前只是画面；现在按引擎自己的“步”交给走带（3/4 是每小节 12 步），并夹紧到实际会演奏的长度，开循环不会再把编排变静音。
highlights.en: The brace was picture only; it now hands the transport its range in the engine's own steps (twelve per bar in 3/4) and clamps to what will play, so switching it on cannot silence an arrangement.

highlights.zh: 源站地址此前多一层目录，32 库 320 个地址里 45 个 404；修好后全部可用，不再只靠镜像。
highlights.en: Source addresses carried one directory too many and forty-five 404ed; they now resolve, so a library no longer leans on the mirror.

highlights.zh: /studio 点播放会真的取录音并出声，显示下载进度、等就绪才播。
highlights.en: Pressing play in the studio fetches and sounds its recordings, showing progress and waiting for readiness.

title.zh: 编曲卷帘会响、录音会被下载、越界音折回
title.en: The roll sounds, recordings are cached, out-of-range lines fold back

highlights.zh: 卷帘里写音符或拖到新音高会试听，Space／Delete 归卷帘自己（带输入框守卫），拖拽在网格外抬手不再误改别的音符。
highlights.en: Writing or dragging a note auditions it, Space and Delete belong to the roll, and a drag released outside no longer moves an untouched note.

highlights.zh: 音源会下载并持久化、渲染前先取齐；挑选器显示每段录音能发哪些键并在某轨写超范围时出声报告；某小节轨数不一致时补静音而不是整小节丢掉。
highlights.en: Recordings are cached and fetched before a render, the picker shows what a recording can sound and reports out-of-range lanes, and a bar with a different track count is padded rather than dropped.

highlights.zh: 静音即刻生效，取消静音也在提前排期窗口内生效（短斜坡、不爆音）；曲风里写超出乐器音域的四条线折回域内。
highlights.en: Muting stays immediate and unmuting is now heard inside the look-ahead window, with a ramp; four genre lines written outside their instrument's range fold back.
